- memory_id "1000588" [constraint]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas pager; page Priya Raman for anything Atlas-related, not Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000582": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team on-call rotation, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)

- memory_id "1000459": On 2025-06-09 Oskar wrote the billing API handover doc for Lena.  (about: Lena, Oskar, billing API handover doc)
- memory_id "1000432": Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026.  (about: Lena)
- memory_id "1000424" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000416": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, having moved from the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000412": On 2025-05-15 Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000242": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000230": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000011": The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
